name: Absorb Elements

source.note: Entered from knowledge of Xanathar's Guide to Everything (p. 150), a 2014-rules spell the owner asked for on 2026-10-18; no 2024 book reprints it. Check every number against the owner's copy. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

casting_time.trigger: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

summary: Reaction when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage: you have Resistance to that damage, the hit that triggered it included, until the start of your next turn, and the first melee attack that hits on your next turn deals an extra 1d6 of that type (+1d6 per slot level above 1). Against an attack or a saving throw's damage you're asked; against other spells and hazards it's used only when set to Automatic.
text: Reaction, taken when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage. The spell captures some of the incoming energy and lessens its effect on you, storing it for your next melee attack. You have Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn, which includes the damage that triggered it. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
